description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
